title: Divisible by 3, LSB First
constraints: Bits of a number arrive **least significant bit first**, one per rising edge with `valid`. After each edge, `d3 = 1` when the number received so far is divisible by 3 (combinational from state). Reset starts a new number (`d3 = 1`).
hints: MSB-first is easy (n → 2n + b). LSB-first adds b·2^k, and 2^k mod 3 alternates 1, 2, 1, 2, …
So track the remainder (0–2) **and** whether the next bit has weight 1 or 2: 3 × 2 = 6 states, 3 flops.
With weight w: r ← (r + w·b) mod 3, then w ← 3 − w.
